summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Attendees & Check-in Tab. All 41 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed critical frontend bug (SelectItem empty value causing React error in Add Attendee modal). Full check-in workflow verified: Create attendee, QR check-in, Manual check-in, Undo check-in. Live metrics, devices sidebar, locations sidebar, search, filter, and pagination all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: SelectItem with empty string value ('') in Add Attendee modal was causing React error - changed to 'none' value
All Attendees APIs properly implemented with validation (attendee_name required)
QR code generation uses UUID format: QR-{uuid}
QR check-in validates: invalid QR returns error, already checked-in returns error, wrong event returns error
Manual check-in and Undo check-in work correctly with proper status updates
Metrics API correctly calculates: total_registrations, total_checked_in, no_show_rate, checkin_percentage, peak_checkin_time, last_checkin_ago
Device tracking works - devices are created/updated on QR check-in with device_name
Location stats are tracked from check-in logs
Sync from registrations creates attendees from completed registrations that don't have attendee records
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing. Event ID 1 has multiple test attendees (TEST_* prefix). Alice Smith exists with QR code QR-f42146ae-6807-43ad-a163-71fb5c2fc72d. Multiple devices registered: Web Scanner, Test Scanner, Scanner 1, etc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendees & Check-in Tab fully functional. All 10 attendee APIs tested: GET /attendees (with filters, search, pagination), GET /attendees/metrics, GET /attendees/devices, GET /attendees/locations, GET /attendees/:id, POST /attendees (create), POST /attendees/sync, POST /attendees/qr-checkin, POST /attendees/:id/checkin, POST /attendees/:id/undo-checkin. Frontend displays: 4 Live Metrics cards (Checked In, Peak Check-in Time, Last Check-in, No-Show Rate), Search input, Checked-in only checkbox, Sync from Registrations button, Launch Scanner button, Add Attendee button, Attendees table with columns (Attendee, Ticket Type, Check-in Time, Status, Actions), Active Devices sidebar, Check-in Locations sidebar, Pagination. Actions dropdown shows Manual Check-in/Undo Check-in based on status.

api_get_attendees_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/attendees returns paginated list with filters (checkin_status) and search (name, email, qr_code)

api_get_checkin_metrics.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/attendees/metrics returns total_registrations, total_checked_in, no_show_rate, checkin_percentage, peak_checkin_time, last_checkin_ago

api_get_active_devices.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/attendees/devices returns list of devices with device_name, total_scans, status, battery_level

api_create_attendee.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/attendees creates attendee with auto-generated QR code (QR-{uuid})

api_sync_attendees.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/attendees/sync creates attendees from completed registrations

api_qr_checkin.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/attendees/qr-checkin validates QR code, prevents duplicates, tracks device and location

api_manual_checkin.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/attendees/:id/checkin performs manual check-in with optional location

api_undo_checkin.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/attendees/:id/undo-checkin reverts check-in status to not_checked_in

api_get_attendee_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/attendees/:id returns single attendee, 404 for not found

frontend_live_metrics_cards.details: 4 cards display: Checked In (X/Y, percentage), Peak Check-in Time, Last Check-in (time ago), No-Show Rate

frontend_search.details: Search filters by name or QR code

frontend_checked_in_filter.details: Checkbox filters to show only checked-in attendees

frontend_sync_button.details: Sync from Registrations button syncs attendees and shows toast with count

frontend_add_attendee_modal.details: Modal has fields: Full Name (required), Email (optional), Ticket Type (optional)

frontend_qr_scanner_dialog.details: Dialog has QR Code Value input and Location dropdown (Main Gate, VIP Entrance, Side Entrance, Registration Desk)

frontend_attendees_table.details: Table displays: Attendee (name, email/QR), Ticket Type, Check-in Time, Status (Checked In/Not Here/No Show), Actions

frontend_actions_dropdown.details: Shows Manual Check-in for not checked-in, Undo Check-in for checked-in, plus Print Badge and View QR Code

frontend_active_devices_sidebar.details: Shows device name, scan count, online/offline status indicator

frontend_locations_sidebar.details: Shows location name, check-in count, last check-in time ago

frontend_pagination.details: Shows 'Showing X-Y of Z attendees' with Previous/Next buttons

frontend_status_badges.details: Checked In (green), Not Here (gray), No Show (red) badges display correctly

bug_fixed.issue: Add Attendee modal not opening due to React error in SelectItem component
bug_fixed.root_cause: SelectItem with empty string value ('') is not allowed by Radix UI Select
bug_fixed.fix: Changed SelectItem value from '' to 'none' and updated onValueChange handler to check for 'none' value
